import json,itertools,time
import sympy as S
start=time.monotonic();t=S.Symbol('t')
s=json.load(open('research/artifacts/generated-results/elkies-k3-r17-norm12-orbit11952-direct-fibration-v1.json'))
pol=lambda a:S.Poly.from_list(list(map(S.Rational,reversed(a))),t,domain=S.QQ)
X=[(pol(a['X']['numerator_coefficients_low_to_high']),pol(a['X']['denominator_coefficients_low_to_high'])) for a in s['sections']['records']]
# Zero loci of each section and abscissa coincidences; cancel before using poles.
raw=[]
for i,(n,d) in enumerate(X):
 assert S.gcd(n,d).degree()==0
 if d.degree()>0:raw.append((f'pole-{i}',1<<i,d.sqf_part()))
for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(17),2):
 n=X[i][0]*X[j][1]-X[j][0]*X[i][1];d=X[i][1]*X[j][1]
 n=n.exquo(S.gcd(n,d));raw.append((f'pair-{i}-{j}',(1<<i)|(1<<j),n.sqf_part()))
def modpoly(f,p):
 return S.Poly.from_list([int(c.p)%p*pow(int(c.q),-1,p)%p for c in f.all_coeffs()],t,modulus=p)
p=131;mods=[modpoly(g,p) for _,_,g in raw]
ret=[];hits=0
for i,j in itertools.combinations(range(len(raw)),2):
 if S.gcd(mods[i],mods[j]).degree()==0:continue
 hits+=1;g=S.gcd(raw[i][2],raw[j][2])
 if g.degree()>0:
  ret.append(dict(left=raw[i][0],right=raw[j][0],degree=g.degree(),coefficients=list(map(str,reversed(g.monic().all_coeffs())))))
print(json.dumps(dict(loci=len(raw),modular_pairs=hits,incidences=ret,elapsed=time.monotonic()-start),indent=2))
